meta.note: Names kept from the app stylesheet; values re-harmonised in OKLCH (tetrad on hue 195) and extended with pop, on-*, *-text, focus, colour-blind and high-contrast themes.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and window background. The canvas every surface sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, menus. Text `text`, `text-2`, `text-3` and `accent-text` all read on it in every theme.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken areas inside a surface: the Ask bar, hover rows, code blocks, bottom panel tabs.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, pressed state of ghost controls, toggle track when off.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and cards. Decorative; never the only cue for a control edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges: inputs, secondary buttons, the command palette frame. ≥3:1 on `surface` and `bg` in every theme.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `bg` and every `surface-*`. The ink: a very deep teal, not pure black (except high-contrast themes).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, nav items, descriptions. ≥4.5:1 on `bg` and every `surface-*`.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, overlines, placeholders. Still ≥4.5:1 on every surface, so it is safe for real information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand aqua as a FILL: primary buttons, the active toggle track, selection highlights, the live dot. Always paired with `on-accent` text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`, `accent-strong` and on the bright `ok`, `warn`, `info`, `coral`, `sun`, `grape` fills. Deep ink, never white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on `bg` and every `surface-*`. Use this, not `accent`, whenever the aqua is text or an outline.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent` fills. Keeps `on-accent` text legible.

tokens.name: accent-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected tabs, the active modal nav item and accent chips; text on it is `text` or `accent-text`.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Pop colour as a fill: celebration moments, the Decisions badge count, onboarding steps. Text on it is `on-accent`. Never a status.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral as text or icon on `bg`, `surface` or `coral-weak`.

tokens.name: coral-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for coral chips and callouts; pair with `coral-text`.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Pop colour as a fill: highlights, the "new" marker, streaks and rewards. Text on it is `on-accent`. Never a status.

tokens.name: sun-text
tokens.usage: Sun as text or icon on `bg`, `surface` or `sun-weak`.

tokens.name: sun-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for sun chips and callouts; pair with `sun-text`.

tokens.name: grape
tokens.usage: Pop colour as a fill: agent-vendor tags, Designer accents, the second series in charts. Text on it is `on-accent`. Never a status.

tokens.name: grape-text
tokens.usage: Grape as text or icon on `bg`, `surface` or `grape-weak`.

tokens.name: grape-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for grape chips and callouts; pair with `grape-text`.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success / running as a FILL: the toggle track when on, solid success chips, progress bars. Text on it is `on-accent`. Colour-blind themes turn this sky blue.

tokens.name: ok-text
tokens.usage: Success as text, a dot or an icon on `bg`, `surface` or `ok-weak`. Use this for every small mark, never `ok`.

tokens.name: ok-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for success badges and rows; pair with `ok-text`.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning / needs you as a FILL: the live-pending dot background, approval banners. Text on it is `on-accent`. Colour-blind themes turn this yellow.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Warning as text, a dot or an icon on `bg`, `surface` or `warn-weak`.

tokens.name: warn-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for warning badges, the shell note and pending approvals; pair with `warn-text`.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Critical / danger as a FILL: destructive buttons, the kill switch, critical alerts. Text on it is `on-crit`. Colour-blind themes turn this vermillion.

tokens.name: on-crit
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `crit` fill. White in light themes, ink in night themes.

tokens.name: crit-text
tokens.usage: Danger as text, a dot, an outline or an icon on `bg`, `surface` or `crit-weak`.

tokens.name: crit-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for critical badges, failed rows and the red shell note; pair with `crit-text`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational as a FILL: neutral progress, hints, the first series in charts. Text on it is `on-accent`. Colour-blind themes turn this reddish purple.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info as text, a dot or an icon on `bg`, `surface` or `info-weak`.

tokens.name: info-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info badges and callouts; pair with `info-text`.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Idle / offline marks: dots, icons and the disabled toggle knob ring. ≥3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: idle-weak
tokens.usage: Ground for neutral badges and idle rows; text on it is `text-2`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Outer focus ring, 2px solid. Pair with `focus-halo` as a 2px inner ring so the pair is visible on every fill, `accent` included.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: Inner focus ring (2px) between the control and the `focus` ring. Matches the page ground so the ring never merges with a bright fill.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero and the first-run welcome. Never inside the app shell.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on full-page states (onboarding, empty projects, Release Cockpit summary).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings and section headings inside panels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Codex finished the migration and opened a review.
styles.usage: Default UI text. The app sets `body` on `<body>`.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Push is routed to you on protected branches.
styles.usage: Dense tables, nav items, buttons, inputs, descriptions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field labels, timestamps, badge text at 11.5–12px, helper text in `text-2` or `text-3`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows (`h2` in the app) in `text-3`.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code, commands, transcript lines, log output, textareas.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Keyboard hints, hashes, ids inside badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside rows and columns, chip gaps, input vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card header and body padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, topbar gap, page side gutter on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a page, modal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; above an empty state.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero inner padding on marketing surfaces.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between marketing sections on phone.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between marketing sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard hints, tiny tags, the inner focus ring on small controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, nav items, chips that are not pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons in the shell, cards, the modal nav, popovers. The app default (`--radius`).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, the command palette, large cards, bottom sheet on phone.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Marketing cards, the first-run welcome panel, app-icon style tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, toggles and their knobs, chips that filter. The knob stretches by changing width, never scaleX, so the ends stay round.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards at rest. Night themes use borders instead of shadows; high-contrast themes never use shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the raised toggle knob while pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Modals and the command palette.

duration.note: Everything under 250ms. The app must feel instant; motion only confirms a change in state. Honour prefers-reduced-motion by dropping to `duration-instant`.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed colour changes, focus ring appearance.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Chips, tabs, badges changing tone; press-in of a button or toggle knob.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Toggle knob travel, menu and popover open, panel reveal. Reads as "instant but connected".

tokens.name: duration-slide
tokens.usage: Side panel and bottom sheet slides; the first-run welcome stepping forward.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Only for one-time moments: the first-run mark reveal. Never for repeated UI.

easing.note: Springs are approximated with one overshooting cubic-bezier so there is no JS animation library. Layer physics first, squash on top.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for anything moving into place: panels, menus, knob travel in Firm mode.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: closing menus, dismissed toasts.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: The Balanced toggle: a damped spring with a small overshoot that settles about 22% faster than ease-out at the same duration.

tokens.name: ease-elastic
tokens.usage: The Elastic toggle preset and celebration pops. Use sparingly.
